'''Montra Varn''' was an undercover [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] of the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] stationed in the [[Mon Cala Imperial garrison|Imperial garrison]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]]. Holding the [[Military rank/Legends|rank]] of [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]], she was tasked to create discord between the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|peoples]].<ref name="SoR" />
